ar_relief_rate: rate of the invoice transaction date
credit_notes: an invoice whose line_items carry cancels_invoice_id cancels that invoice; both stay in the books
fx_conversion: base_minor = round(amount_minor * rate * 10^(exp_base - exp_src)), once per document
fx_rate_date_basis: local calendar date in the company timezone; invoice: issued_at, payment: timestamp
fx_rate_meaning: units of target_currency per 1 unit of source_currency
revenue_posting: Dr 1200 = document base amount; one Cr 4000 row per line item, the base amount split by line amounts with largest remainder (ties to the earlier line)
unapplied_cash: account 2400 holds only cash that cannot be applied: a whole receipt with invoice_refs = null, or the part of a receipt exceeding the open balance of the invoices it references (overpayment), converted at the payment's policy rate
vat: a line item with description 'VAT 12%' must equal round_half_even(12% x the sum of the other line items of the same invoice), in the invoice currency's minor units
